features: Perfect fit & protection: Designed for the Gabit Smart Ring, this durable silicone cover shields your ring from scratches, scuffs, and daily wear. Ideal for workouts and everyday use.
Flexible size options: Comes in two size variants – Small (fits ring sizes 6, 7, 8) and Medium (fits sizes 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14). Offers a sleek and secure fit.
Durable: Made from premium, skin-friendly silicone that is elastic, ultra-thin and non-bulky, maintaining the natural feel and comfort of your ring.

Colourful: Available in multiple vibrant color options - Black, Blue, White, Violet, Grey, Green and Aqua. Choose the perfect combination to match your ring size, complement your outfits, and suit your style — ideal for adding a personal touch to your daily wear.
Easy to use: Simply stretch and slide the protector over your ring — quick, effortless, and secure.
Ideal for fitness enthusiasts: Engineered for fitness lovers, the slim cover stays firmly in place during gym sessions and physical activity, without disrupting ring performance.
Slim and lightweight: At just 1.5g, the ultra-thin design ensures a natural feel and minimal bulk - so light, you’ll forget it’s there.

No need to remove during charging: Designed with precise dimensions, this silicone skin allows your Gabit Smart Ring to charge seamlessly without taking it off. Simply place the ring on the charger as usual, cover doesn't interfere with charging speed or connection.

Other Usage: Secure fit for weightlifting, HIIT, running, cycling, yoga, and more. Also ideal for hiking, sports, cooking, cleaning, gardening, and daily tasks. Keeps your Gabit Smart Ring protected in every activity.
description: Protect your Gabit Smart Ring in style with this silicone cover. Designed for a perfect fit, it guards against scratches and everyday wear, without affecting sensor accuracy. Lightweight, comfortable, and available in multiple sizes and colors.
